verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec and renders a REST reference generated from it at docs/api-reference, and that page says users can enter an API key, fill in parameters and send requests to see live responses. However, an inspection of the same page found it mounts RedocStandalone with no documented live try-it runner, so the runnable-examples part is uncertain. Missing for 10: unambiguous confirmation of an in-browser try-it runner, documented runnable code examples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Enter your API key, fill in the parameters, and send the request to see the live response.
docs/api-reference is the rendered REST reference for the public API
Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json
